name: Calculator
script: const display = document.getElementById('calcDisplay'); const keys = ['7','8','9','/','4','5','6','*','1','2','3','-','C','0','=','+']; const grid = document.getElementById('calcKeys'); keys.forEach(k => { const btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.innerText = k; btn.style.cssText = 'font-size:24px; border-radius:10px; border:none; background:#444; color:white; cursor:pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);'; if(k === 'C' || k === '=') btn.style.background = '#e74c3c'; btn.onclick = () => { if(k==='C') display.value = ''; else if(k==='=') { try { display.value = eval(display.value) } catch(e) { display.value = 'Error' } } else display.value += k; }; grid.appendChild(btn); });

name: Camera
script: const video = document.getElementById('cameraFeed'); const btn = document.getElementById('captureBtn'); const canvas = document.getElementById('snapshot'); navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: 'environment' } }).then(stream => { video.srcObject = stream; window.currentCameraStream = stream; }).catch(err => { alert('Camera access denied or device has no camera.'); }); btn.addEventListener('click', () => { canvas.width = video.videoWidth; canvas.height = video.videoHeight; canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); const photoData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png'); alert('Photo Captured! Check browser console for Image Data.'); console.log(photoData); });

name: Notes
script: const appId = 'com.user.notes'; const input = document.getElementById('noteInput'); const savedData = SystemOS.Storage.load(appId); if (savedData && savedData.text) { input.value = savedData.text; } document.getElementById('saveBtn').addEventListener('click', () => { SystemOS.Storage.save(appId, { text: input.value }); alert('Note Saved Successfully!'); });

name: App Builder
template: 🛠️ App Studio
script: const getVal = id => document.getElementById(id).value; const getConfig = () => { let iconVal = getVal('bldIcon'); if (iconVal.startsWith('http') || iconVal.startsWith('data:image')) { iconVal = ''; } return { id: getVal('bldId'), name: getVal('bldName'), icon: iconVal, color: getVal('bldColor'), template: getVal('bldHtml'), script: getVal('bldJs') }; }; document.getElementById('bldInstallBtn').onclick = () => { const conf = getConfig(); if(!conf.id || !conf.name) return alert('App ID and Name are required!'); if(SystemOS.registry[conf.id] && !confirm('App already exists. Overwrite?')) return; SystemOS.install(conf); alert(conf.name + ' installed directly to OS!'); }; document.getElementById('bldDownloadBtn').onclick = () => { const conf = getConfig(); const dataStr = 'data:text/json;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(conf, null, 2)); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = dataStr; a.download = conf.name.replace(/\s+/g, '').toLowerCase() + '.json'; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a); };

name: Themes
template: Appearance
script: const lightBtn = document.getElementById('lightBtn'); const darkBtn = document.getElementById('darkBtn'); const status = document.getElementById('themeStatus'); function setTheme(isDark) { if(isDark) { document.body.classList.add('dark-mode'); localStorage.setItem('os_theme', 'dark'); status.innerText = 'Dark Mode is Active'; darkBtn.style.borderColor = '#3498db'; lightBtn.style.borderColor = '#bdc3c7'; } else { document.body.classList.remove('dark-mode'); localStorage.setItem('os_theme', 'light'); status.innerText = 'Light Mode is Active'; lightBtn.style.borderColor = '#3498db'; darkBtn.style.borderColor = '#2c3e50'; } } lightBtn.onclick = () => setTheme(false); darkBtn.onclick = () => setTheme(true); const current = localStorage.getItem('os_theme'); setTheme(current === 'dark');
